title: Compact Infill
subtitle: Dense Oslo block · strong shadow study
description: A tight urban study area surrounded by mature apartment blocks. The simplified context is derived from OpenStreetMap footprints and the terrain from Kartverket DTM1.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap site extract (buildings, roads, trees, land cover)

simplified: Footprints simplified with a 1.2 m tolerance; building relations omitted
Heights from height, building:levels, or a typology fallback
Terrain sampled on a 40 × 47 grid and recentered to the origin
Study boundary is authored, not a cadastral parcel
Roads are OSM centrelines with illustrative widths by highway class; tunnels omitted
Trees are mapped OSM positions (natural=tree nodes, natural=tree_row lines every 8 m) drawn with illustrative, position-varied sizes and tints
Land cover is illustrative OSM ground tints clipped to terrain and simplified at 0.5 m; areas below 4 m² and incomplete rings omitted; multipolygon inner rings ignored

[heights] Building heights and simple gables measured from Kartverket's surface model (282 gabled, 161 flat, 77 other shapes drawn flat at their measured height); 0 not seen in the surface model keep the storey estimate. Not survey data.

[noise] Road-noise bands are Statens vegvesen's strategic noise map (Lden and Lnight, calculated for 2021, CNOSSOS-EU), clipped to the terrain extent and simplified at 0.4 m; shown as published, not calculated here

layers.dataset: Høyde DOM1 (surface model, NHM), roof fit
layers.useLimitation: Heights are measured from a lidar surface model, not surveyed. Lidar and map epochs differ.

layers.attribution: Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by Statens vegvesen
layers.useLimitation: Datasettet skal ikke brukes til å vurdere behov for tiltak på enkeltbygg. Det må utføres egne beregninger for dette. (Not for assessing the need for measures on individual buildings; separate calculations are required.)
